summary: This is an Apache web server configuration block that sets up a virtual host listening on port 80 (standard HTTP). It tells Apache that when someone visits www.example.com, serve files from the /www/domain directory on the server.

explanations.1: The asterisk means this virtual host listens on all network interfaces; the :80 specifies the HTTP port.
explanations.3: DocumentRoot is the directory path where Apache looks for the website files to serve to visitors.
